name: Computer Security Checkup
summary: A local security checkup with over 300 checks: rootkits, malware, persistence, open ports, kernel, accounts, secrets, SSH and services. Each result is explained, and many can be fixed with one confirmed click.

screenshots.alt: The Computer Security Checkup page showing a summary and a table of passing, review and warning checks

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: Read local firewall, kernel, account, mount, service and security configuration files
Read the operating system's local TCP and UDP listener tables to identify ports to review
Read the local process list to spot malware and name the program that holds a port
Change a security setting you pick and confirm, after the system administrator prompt
